title: The after-sync step of Sync from live runs on Joomla 3
steps: Run sync-joomla-after.php on PHP 7.4 against a Joomla 3 shaped tree (no service container) and a Joomla 4+ shaped one.
expect: Joomla 3: TRACY_RESULT rebuild=menu:ok,categories:ok,assets:ok,tags:ok, no getContainer error, no application started.
Joomla 4+: the administrator application is started first, every rebuild ok.

tests: Joomla 3: the nested sets rebuild with no service container
Joomla 4 and later: the administrator application is started first
